title: 把复杂系统讲清楚的三个习惯
content:
长期维护同一套渲染器之后，我逐渐相信：**清晰不是写作技巧，而是结构习惯**。

## 先写结论

读者愿意读下去，是因为第一段就告诉他结论是什么、为什么与他有关。把推导过程留在后面，把结论提前。

## 再分层

- 一句话摘要：谁、做了什么、结果如何
- 一段展开：关键约束和取舍
- 细节补充：数据、边界条件和失败案例

## 最后留白

> 好的文档不是把知道的都写出来，而是让读者能快速找到他需要的那一部分。

三段式结构让卡片在任意屏幕上都能自然增长，不需要为了塞进一屏而删掉信息。

translation.title: Three habits for explaining complex systems
translation.content:
After maintaining the same renderer for a long time, I have come to believe that **clarity is not a writing trick but a structural habit**.

## State the conclusion first

Readers keep reading because the first paragraph tells them what the conclusion is and why it matters to them. Put the reasoning later and bring the conclusion forward.

## Then layer it

- One-sentence summary: who did what, and with what result
- One paragraph: key constraints and trade-offs
- Details: data, edge cases, and failure modes

## Leave room at the end

> A good document is not one that writes down everything you know, but one that lets readers quickly find the part they need.

The three-part structure lets a card grow naturally on any screen without deleting information to fit one viewport.
